_note: Machine-readable copy of story/bible.md section 5. tools/art reads this file first. Keep it in sync with the bible.
style: Korean webtoon style, full colour, clean digital linework with soft cel shading, cinematic framing, expressive faces. Palette: warm paper cream, ink black, ash grey, ochre/brass lamp light, cold teal reserved for the Silent, and vermilion reserved only for word power. No purple, no violet, no blue neon

characters.dan: 24-year-old East-Slavic man, 178 cm, lean and slightly hunched, tired but kind face, short messy black hair with a cowlick, dark brown eyes with faint dark circles, plain round black-frame glasses (nothing attached, no tape), light stubble. Rumpled pale-grey button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, loosened dark-olive chinos, white sneakers, a mustard-yellow office lanyard around his neck, a yellow carpenter pencil behind his right ear
characters.mira: 23-year-old athletic woman, 170 cm, clearly curvy hourglass figure with full bust, very slim waist, wide hips and long legs, sharp narrow face, olive-tan skin, amber-gold half-lidded dry unimpressed eyes, small scar through her left eyebrow, dark-brown choppy shoulder-length hair tied in a short ponytail with loose strands. Snug black crop top with a bit of toned midriff, short fitted olive-khaki climbing jacket open over it, long cream scarf, high-waisted tight black climbing trousers with belts and thigh straps, black fingerless gloves, rust-brown boots, a worn backpack with a coil of rope, a frayed vermilion cord bracelet on her LEFT wrist only (right wrist bare). Default expression: dry, unimpressed, half-lidded
characters.silent: tall (2.3 m) gaunt humanoid with a smooth, featureless, matte paper-white head and face (no eyes, no nose), a single thin vertical teal seam where a mouth would be. Long arms and long thin fingers like unbound pages. Tattered, faded grey-teal remnants of human clothing, ink-teal drips from the fingertips, body edges dissolving into cold teal shadow
characters.keeper: man of indeterminate age, seen only from the nose down: pale thin face, calm small smile, ink-stained fingertips. Long ink-black robe with a high deep hood that hides the eyes, sleeves embroidered with fine ochre thread script, a brass quill pen tucked in the sleeve
characters.system: a floating rectangular panel of aged cream paper with soft torn edges, a thin double border in vermilion, small notched corners, blank inside (text added later), a faint round ink-stamp seal in the bottom-right corner, slightly tilted 2-3 degrees, casting a soft shadow on the scene; no avatar, no face, never blue, never neon
characters.pip: 11-year-old boy, 138 cm, skinny and quick, light-brown skin, huge dark eyes, a gap between the front teeth, messy sand-coloured hair under a too-big grey flat cap, oversized patched brown coat with rolled sleeves and many pockets, bare ankles, mismatched boots, a small brass hand-bell without a clapper hanging on a string around his neck. Default expression: cheeky sideways grin, one eyebrow up
characters.trader: 50-year-old stout man, 175 cm, round-shouldered, ruddy weathered face, grey stubble, small shrewd friendly eyes, copper-rimmed spectacles pushed up on his forehead, a flat cloth cap, a long leather apron stained black with ink over a patched brown tunic with rolled sleeves, forearms and fingertips permanently dyed black. No text on the apron. Default expression: genial and greedy, weighing everything he sees
characters.lina_human: 14-year-old girl, 150 cm, thin, olive-tan skin like Mira, big amber eyes, long dark-brown hair in two loose braids, a vermilion cord bracelet on her left wrist (bright when seen in memory, faded and frayed later), a plain patched ash-grey dress, bare feet in rope sandals. Default expression: wide-eyed, curious, humming
characters.ruk: Ruk Marl, 26-year-old man, 190 cm, tall, elegant and cold, narrow pale face with sharp cheekbones, bored half-lidded steel-grey eyes, slicked-back ash-white hair with one long strand falling over his left eye, a faint contemptuous half-smile. Floor-length ink-black double-breasted coat with a stiff high collar and rows of small polished brass-and-enamel rank badges pinned across the chest like medals (abstract shapes, no markings), white leather gloves, polished black boots with brass heel plates, a heavy brass-cornered black ledger book carried under his left arm, a pair of folded gold-rimmed spectacles hanging on a chain from his lapel (never worn). His bought words glow vermilion with a brass sheen. Default expression: bored contempt, chin slightly raised
characters.soup: Soup, 52-year-old giant of a man, 205 cm, enormously broad and soft, round bald head with a few grey wisps above the ears, thick grey-brown beard braided into two short plaits, sleepy kind heavy-lidded brown eyes, flour-pale cheeks. Faded patched cream apron over a huge sleeveless oatmeal-knit jumper, thick forearms scarred with old burn marks, a long wooden ladle tucked through his belt like a sword, a folded kitchen cloth on one shoulder, soft felt slippers. Moves slowly and carefully, ducks under low beams. Over his kitchen hangs a brass lamp whose flame is vermilion (his given-away word). Default expression: gentle, calm, slightly absent
characters.thorn: Miss Thorn, 72-year-old woman, 155 cm, ramrod straight, thin and sharp, silver-white hair in a tight severe bun held by a long polished bone hairpin, deeply lined face with bright pale-grey eyes behind small round half-moon spectacles on a silver chain. Dove-grey tweed jacket and long grey skirt with a high pale lace collar, black lace gloves, a thin ebony cane hooked over her forearm. NOTHING RED on her clothes or body: the only red on her is the bead of vermilion ink at the nib of the slim black fountain pen she holds between two fingers like a conductor's baton. Default expression: patient, dry, faintly amused
characters.herald: the Ledger's herald, 38-year-old man, 195 cm, absurdly tall and thin with a very long neck, narrow chalk-white face with thick painted black eyebrows, a tall stiff black funnel-shaped hat, long vertically striped ash-and-black coat with a wide sash of folded paper, white gloves, a huge brass speaking-horn as long as his arm raised in one hand, a small double-circle Ledger pin on his lapel (abstract shape, no letters). Theatrical posture, chest out, chin up
characters.oldman: the old man at the Index, 80-year-old man, 160 cm, bent like a question mark, long white eyebrows like moss over one milky-white blind eye and one sharp black eye, deeply wrinkled walnut-brown skin, wispy white beard. Patched ash-green wool cloak with the hood pushed back, a leather apron, fingers stained grey with ink dust; carries a very long-handled sweeping brush taller than himself and a small bucket of grey slurry. Default expression: calm, riddling, faint knowing smile
characters.citizen: an ordinary resident of Margin (any age or build, varied faces) in patched ash-grey, ochre and cream clothes with many pockets and rope-soled shoes; in crowds draw a mixed busy crowd, a few with ink-stained fingers, nobody in red
characters.hunter: a Ledger bounty hunter, 30-year-old, broad and wiry, black leather coat with a hooded cowl, a coil of weighted rope over one shoulder, a brass hand-lantern with a narrow beam in one hand and a hooked pole in the other, lower face covered by a grey cloth mask, hard dark eyes
characters.clerk: a Ledger clerk, 45-year-old thin man, 175 cm, hunched at a high desk, greyish skin, shaven head with a few ink stains, enormous round brass-rimmed spectacles that magnify his eyes, black sleeve-guards over a grey waistcoat, inky fingers, a rubber-stamp ring on his index finger. Default expression: bored politeness
characters.odessa: Odessa Marl, 50-year-old woman, 172 cm, impeccably composed, high-collared black coat-dress, thin brass-rimmed half-moon glasses on a chain, a single small brass brooch shaped like balance scales (no letters), silver-streaked black hair swept into a smooth coil, ice-pale eyes, a thin gracious smile that does not reach the eyes; perfectly still, hands folded, never raises her voice. Sepia memory in s2e10, in person from s2e11
characters.dash: Dash, sergeant of the Line, 28-year-old woman, long-legged runner's build, freckles, wind-blown copper-brown hair in a long braid, ash-grey short uniform jacket with one white horizontal stripe across the chest, a satchel, iron bracket-cuffs with no letters, always mid-stride. Default expression: breathless, alert
characters.period: Judge Period, 60-year-old man, short and square, bald, heavy brows, small round black glasses, ash-grey judge robe with a single large black round button at the collar, a black round stamp in his fist. Default expression: final. No letters on the robe or the stamp
characters.tally: Tally, 30-year-old woman, 170 cm, wiry, tan skin, black hair with one white streak, quick black eyes, a black-and-white patched cloak sewn with dozens of small stolen shiny objects (keys, buttons, spoons, no letters), fingerless white gloves, counting beads wound around her left hand, a sack of amber jars. Default expression: amused, calculating
characters.bell: Bell, an 8-year-old girl, small, fair skin, round face, straw-blonde hair in a neat bob, an expensive little ink-black coat with brass buttons, a tiny brass bell sewn to her collar. Fully clothed, ordinary child proportions, never posed for appeal. Default expression: curious, polite, a child's seriousness
characters.hob: Hob, 62-year-old lift-keeper of the Gutter, 180 cm, broad and stooped, shaggy iron-grey hair and a short grey beard, oil-black hands, deep-set tired eyes under heavy brows. Patched dark-brown leather apron over a faded grey work shirt, rolled sleeves, a heavy iron wrench in one hand, a grease rag in his belt, a thick coil of cable over one shoulder. Default expression: grumpy, guarded, secretly kind

locations.office-night: open-plan engineering office at 2 AM, empty. Cold fluorescent grey-green light from the ceiling, warm sodium-orange glow of city lights through the big window, a single glowing monitor with blueprint drawings, rolled drawings, a cold coffee mug, cluttered desk; lonely, slightly sickly light
locations.tower-exterior: a colossal bone-white limestone tower rising through cream clouds beyond the frame, spiral balconies, thousands of tiny vermilion glowing glyph-shaped sparks drifting upward like lanterns, empty stone plaza at dusk, sky dusty apricot at the horizon to grey-teal above
locations.corridor: narrow stone corridor, soot-dark brown walls with torn paper pages glued on them, occasional vermilion lantern-words dripping a little light, cold teal darkness at the far end
locations.room: tiny round safe room, ochre walls scratched all over with names, an old mattress and rusty tin cans, a bare lamp hanging from the ceiling whose flame has a vermilion core; warm ochre light, cosy and fragile
locations.hall: a vast colonnade hall of pale stone pillars, dim ash-grey light from high slits, Silent figures standing along the walls with blank faces turned toward the sound, a worn fresco of two girls holding hands near the exit arch
locations.s1e04:hall: huge round library, shelves from floor to a domed ceiling, thousands of glass jars each holding a glowing vermilion word like fireflies, warm amber light, paper-strewn floor, a high-backed dark wooden chair in the centre; behind the chair a sealed door covered with vermilion wax seals
locations.gate: colossal house-high stone arch with no handle or lock, one long line of faint engraved vermilion glyphs above it, cold teal shadows pooling at the base
locations.dungeon: cold bare stone hall with a high black wooden door at the far end, iron bands on the door, teal shadow, ash-grey light
locations.flash: pure white overexposed frame with a faint vermilion crack of light
locations.black: almost entirely black frame, deep ink darkness with only a faint rim light
locations.sky: open sky above the Tower, cream clouds, dusty apricot light fading to grey-teal
locations.s1e06:corridor: the Stair of Echoes: a vast vertical round shaft with a narrow spiral stone stair without a railing, walls covered in thousands of overlapping pale paper sheets like scales, faint ripples of sound visible on the paper, cold teal darkness below, a small warm ochre glow far above
locations.s1e07:street: the Ink Market: a crowded bazaar on a wide landing inside the Tower, crooked wooden stalls under patched paper awnings, hanging glass bottles of black ink and small jars with one vermilion spark each, ochre lanterns, steam, ropes and pulleys, hooded traders; warm and cramped; no readable signs or lettering
locations.s1e08:street: a dead-end stone alley behind the Ink Market: damp soot-dark walls, stacked empty crates and broken ink jars, a single rusty nail in the wall with a scrap of frayed vermilion thread on it, one flickering ochre lantern, cold teal darkness at the far end
locations.s1e08:white: memory scene in warm sepia paper tones, soft blurred paper-grain edges like an old drawing: a tiny cramped family kitchen with one small table, two cups, a few chairs and a small window with soft light (other memory places in this episode: a narrow Tower corridor, the huge round Hall of Words with shelves of jars); only faint vermilion accents
locations.s1e09:tower-exterior: the Wall of Letters: an immense curved inner wall of the Tower made of millions of carved abstract glyph-bricks (unreadable marks, never a real alphabet) and glowing vermilion word-sparks set like bricks, a narrow stone walkway at its foot, one huge endless line of abstract glyphs with a blank gap high near the top, drifting vermilion sparks, dusty apricot light; no readable text anywhere
locations.s1e09:room: a tiny round niche cut into the base of the Wall of Letters: curved walls of abstract glyph-bricks that slowly slot into place by themselves, a bare lamp with a vermilion-hearted flame hanging from the ceiling; warm ochre light, cosy and fragile; no readable text
locations.s1e10:tower-exterior: the stone walkway at the foot of the Wall of Letters at dusk: the curved wall of abstract unreadable glyph-bricks rising behind, a pulsing vermilion gap high above, an ochre lantern on the ground; no readable text
locations.s1e10:corridor: a narrow soot-dark stone corridor ending in a huge black door banded with iron straps (no lettering, no symbols), ochre lantern light, cold teal darkness beyond; torn blank paper pages glued on the walls
locations.s1e10:dungeon: the last hall of the floor: a cold bare stone hall with a high black wooden door banded with iron at the far end, all lamps swept from their hooks and lying broken and unlit on the floor, ash-grey light from high slits, teal shadows, a line of tall Silents standing along the wall; no chair
locations.s1e11:hall: the Hall of Words at the end of its glow: a huge round library with shelves from floor to a domed ceiling holding thousands of glass jars, but the left half of the hall is dark, its jars dim and dead, while the right half still glows amber; a high-backed dark wooden chair in the centre-right; behind the chair a tall sealed door covered with vermilion wax seals (abstract blobs, no markings); paper-strewn floor; no readable text on any jar
locations.s1e11:corridor: a narrow lamp-lit stone passage, low arched ceiling, ochre wall lamps with vermilion-cored flames, a distant amber glow at the far end where the Hall of Words begins; no readable text
locations.s1e12:hall: the Hall of Words in its last hour: a huge round library of glass jars on shelves up to a domed ceiling, the jars flickering and dimming as if breathing out, the high-backed chair empty or half-lit, behind it the tall sealed door covered with vermilion wax seals (abstract blobs, no markings); warm amber light; no readable text
locations.s1e12:sky: open sky above the last door of Floor 1: the huge black iron-banded door has risen into cream clouds like a curtain and a winding stair of pure warm light climbs into the sky; dusty apricot light fading to grey-teal; no readable text anywhere
locations.s2e01:hall: the Hall of Words in its last hour: a huge round library of glass jars on shelves up to a dark domed ceiling, the jars dimming; the high-backed chair at the centre; behind it the tall black door covered with dull vermilion wax seals (abstract blobs, no markings); amber light fading to black; no readable text
locations.s2e01:sky: a narrow stair of pure warm-gold light hanging in an endless black vertical void inside the Tower; the steps burn away from the bottom shedding embers; deep shadow under the steps where a pale Silent can cling; a pinprick of ochre daylight far above; no readable text
locations.s2e01:street: Margin, a vertical city built on shelf-like ledges of the Tower's inner wall: houses stacked like lines on a page, rope bridges, patched canvas awnings, cable lifts on brass wires crossing the open drop, shops hanging from ropes in baskets, thousands of ochre lamps rising into the dark, mixed crowds; at its centre a plaza under an immense ash-black board (the Index) ten storeys tall with thousands of thin glowing abstract rows; cream, ash grey and ochre; no readable signs or text
locations.s2e01:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e02:street: the central plaza of Margin under the immense ash-black Index board: tiers of shelf-ledges, rope bridges and canvas awnings around it, thousands of ochre lamps, a dense mixed crowd; cream, ash grey and ochre; no readable signs or text
locations.s2e02:tower-exterior: a long narrow platform of dark planks jutting off the shelf-wall of Margin over an open vertical drop that falls into black; a straight glowing chalk-line drawn across the middle of the planks; rope rails; packed galleries, ledges and ropes above and behind like theatre seating; warm ochre lamps; no readable text
locations.s2e02:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e03:street: a narrow shelf-alley between two stacks of Margin houses at dusk: rope laundry lines, canvas awnings, iron drain grates in the floor, rooftop ledges above where hunters pass with lanterns; ash grey walls with warm ochre lamp glow; no readable text
locations.s2e03:dungeon: the thieves' stair and the Gutter: a narrow vertical crack in the stone wall of Margin with iron rungs and rope ladders zig-zagging down into the dark; at its bottom a canyon-like slot a few paces wide between two colossal stone columns, hundreds of small warm lanterns strung on wires, patched cloth tents, steam from pots, rope walkways; ochre and ash grey; no readable text
locations.s2e03:room: Soup's kitchen in the Gutter: a long low vaulted stone kitchen with a long scrubbed wooden table, mismatched benches, a huge iron pot on a stone stove, copper ladles, a fan hood above the stove and a small brass lamp hanging with a vermilion flame; warm steam, ochre light; bare hooks, an empty bread basket; no readable text
locations.s2e03:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e05:street: the Gutter market lane and cistern: a wide lane between two colossal stone columns, hundreds of warm lanterns on wires, patched tents, a wall of pinned blank paper slips, stone water cistern with a pipe; ochre and ash grey; no readable text
locations.s2e05:room: Soup's kitchen in the Gutter (same as s2e03:room): long low vaulted stone kitchen, scrubbed table, huge pot, vermilion lamp; no readable text
locations.s2e05:gate: the water-lift station gate: heavy iron gate and bars in front of a stone hall with a giant cable drum and a wooden lift car shaft; ochre lamps; no readable text
locations.s2e05:dungeon: inside the water-lift station: a cavernous stone hall dominated by a giant cable drum, levers, wooden car shaft, dust shafts of lamp light; no readable text
locations.s2e05:sky: the open dark inner wall of the Tower with a huge drop; a thick cable crossing; far away tiny lamps of Margin like stars; vertigo; no readable text
locations.s2e05:hall: the Ledger counter hall: a long severe stone hall with a very high desk, brass lamps, cold high windows, a queue of grey people, two blank placards behind the desk; no readable text
locations.s2e05:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e06:room: the team's attic lodging above a clockmaker's workshop in the Clock District: low sloped timber ceiling, mattresses, a small table, a loudly ticking brass wall clock, a round window glowing with a giant clock face outside; also doubles as Soup's pot corner; no readable text
locations.s2e06:street: the Clock District: stacked tower walls covered with enormous brass-and-stone clock faces without numerals, turning gears set into the walls, plank bridges on chains between towers, an iron clock gate; dawn light; no readable text
locations.s2e06:night-city: the Clock District at night: slanted rooftops, giant dark clock faces glowing faintly, a courtyard with a heavy round vault door with a brass ring, lamp pools in the streets; no readable text
locations.s2e06:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e04:room: Soup's kitchen in the Gutter in cold morning light: long low vaulted stone kitchen, scrubbed table, huge pot, brass lamp with a vermilion flame, three red circles on the plaster wall; no readable text
locations.s2e04:dungeon: the Gutter canyon: a slot a few paces wide between two colossal stone columns, hundreds of lanterns on wires, patched tents, rope walkways and plank bridges high above, hollows under the columns with cold kettles; ochre and ash grey; no readable text
locations.s2e04:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e07:street: Clock District courtyard at dawn: giant clock faces of brass and stone with blank tick marks and no numerals, an open round vault door, hard cel shadows, cream and ochre; no readable text
locations.s2e07:sky: the Running Page: moving plank-lines hung on chains over a black vertical drop inside the Tower, rope rails, vermilion thread-light with no letters, deep blacks, city lamps far below
locations.s2e07:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e08:hall: the Line court: a severe ash-grey hall ruled with thin straight lines, a high bench, hard cel shadows, deep blacks in the gallery; no letters anywhere
locations.s2e08:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e09:hall: the Line court one second after the stamp, same ash-grey ruled hall, cuffs off, the door already in mind; no letters
locations.s2e09:night-city: Clock District at night outside the hour vault: a heavy round door with a brass ring under a giant dark clock face with no numerals; teal shadow in the cracks; no readable text
locations.s2e09:dungeon: the hour vault: a round brass-dark room, walls of locked drawers with no labels, wet stone floor, one ochre lamp, teal marks that are not letters, deep blacks
locations.s2e09:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e10:dungeon: the hour vault a second after a Silent has stepped through a shelf: wet floor, brass drawers, one lamp; no readable text
locations.s2e10:sky: a narrow stone stair under an open drop near the top of Margin; the air shivers, sepia at the edges, real ochre light fighting the memory; no readable text
locations.s2e10:white: a memory in warm sepia paper tones with soft paper-grain edges: a hooded Keeper, a tall smooth-faced Silent, a still woman in black, a small child half-hidden; no labels, no letters
locations.s2e10:hall: the Line court the same day, ash-grey, a pale sepia memory playing small above an open hand; no letters
locations.s2e10:street: a Margin balcony street: laundry lines, ochre lamps, the Gutter a warm crack far below; no readable signs
locations.s2e10:night-city: the same balcony at evening, lamps coming on, a small figure in a black coat above; no readable text
locations.s2e10:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e11:street: the balcony street at night, one second later: lamps, a small girl in a black coat, two adults frozen; no readable text
locations.s2e11:hall: the auction hall: round brass and dark wood, tiered seats, a central pedestal with nothing on it, blank cream sheets with brass seals and no letters, deep blacks
locations.s2e11:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
locations.s2e12:hall: the auction hall collapsing: cracking beams, swinging brass lamps, vermilion sparks, a door-frame still straight, deep blacks; no readable text
locations.s2e12:sky: a door of warm light hanging in the shaft above the ruin, the first steps of a light stair, ochre rim light; no letters on the door
locations.s2e12:dungeon: rubble of the vault corner under the light stair: broken brass, one old glass jar with a blank label and no letters, teal and vermilion catching the glass
locations.s2e12:black: pure near-black darkness with only the single described light source; no readable text
